relevance_note: Single case report of a boy carrying a PSTPIP1 variant: "a heterozygous missense mutation in exon 15 of the PSTPIP1 gene (c.1213C>T, R405C)".
method_note: Read and transcribed by hand; no script transcribed a table. In scope: the patient and both parents (tested: 'Neither parent carries this PSTPIP1 variant.'). Out of scope (not tested for PSTPIP1 and not affected by the disease of interest): the oldest brother (CFTR carrier), the other sibling, the maternal aunt (Wilson's disease, Crohn's disease) and the maternal youngest uncle (Wilson's disease). Variants in other genes recorded for the patient (CFTR F508del, L467F; ATP7B H1069Q) and for the mother (ATP7B H1069Q). CFTR variants are not given to either parent because the paper only says the brother inherited one from each parent without saying which. ATP7B inheritance for the patient recorded as inherited maternal because the paper states the mother carries the same variant; zygosity for ATP7B not stated ('carrier'). Leukemia-cell findings (bi-allelic CDKN2A/CDKN2B deletion, karyotype) are somatic and not recorded as variants; Leiden, prothrombin and MTHFR mutations were stated as excluded and get no rows. Pathogenicity left not reported: the only classification ('the mutation is pathogenic') is attributed to the authors of ref [8]; the functional statement (impaired interaction with WASP) is likewise from ref [8] and is recorded as cited earlier work. Age: only '20-month-old' at referral/presentation is given; recorded as age at last evaluation (time of report), no onset age stated ('began a month earlier'). Inflammatory markers: text says 'Inflammatory markers were not clearly elevated' on first admission while Table 2 lists CRP 10.64 mg/l against normal 0-5 (bold formatting lost in conversion); the hedged statement was not treated as exclusion and the checklist item is not reported. Other Table 2 values (AST, LDH, IgE, fibrinogen, etc.) were not converted into features by comparison with normal ranges. HLH was suspected but 'Findings of bone marrow and lumbar puncture were not consistent with HLH'; no HLH row. Enterocolitis mapped to the checklist item 'inflammatory bowel disease or colitis' as observed (enterocolitis includes colon inflammation; cause not stated). Parents' checklist rows are all not reported ('both are healthy' names no specific feature).
